input: q:Nat; A:StoredMatrix (2^(q+1)) (2^(q+1)), materialized signed real SO matrix in Gray-ordered numeric coordinates
hermite_source_premises: No new Hermite public premise. Generic SO premises must be discharged by the actual stored completion consumer; a charged bit/bond LE-to-Gray input reindexer is a separate interface unless implemented here.
actual_producer: compileGray binds one actual stored square sweep, forms its reverse/inverse log with charged record reads/angle negations/list writes, emits each actual plane through GrayTarget.discover, GrayTarget.word, ExplicitControls.selected, charged real coefficient/angle instantiation and persistent chronological append
sealed_semantic_signature: theorem compileGray_eval {q:Nat} (A:StoredMatrix (2^(q+1)) (2^(q+1))) (hO:(denote A).transpose * denote A = 1) (hD:(denote A).det=1) : evalPrimitiveCircuit (compileGray A).value = GrayGivensCompiler.transport (GrayBasis.equiv (q+1)) (denote A)

chronology: Elimination log reduces A to identity; reverse log and negate each elimination angle first. Then negate again exactly when the first Gray endpoint has target bit1. evalPrimitiveCircuit executes list head first; stepsMatrix multiplies later steps on the left.
phase_and_wires: Exact signed matrix action, not up to phase. q+1 existing wires, GrayBasis.equiv little-endian physical bits. Explicit increasing skip controls; no oracle or added ancilla.
